resources.string: Reads Hebrew text from messaging apps to detect offensive content and protect children from cyberbullying.
Persistent indicator that Shomer.AI monitoring is running
Protecting your child from harmful content

This app monitors Hebrew text messages in WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and Messenger on this device.

Both messages your child receives (inbound) and messages they send (outbound) are checked for offensive, abusive, hate, violent, or inappropriate content.

Captured text is processed on our secure server and results are sent to the parent's device. Message text is not stored permanently.

By continuing, the guardian confirms they have explained this monitoring to the child and have obtained consent from all parties as required by applicable law.
I am the guardian of the child using this device and I consent to monitoring
The child has been informed that this device is monitored
Enter pairing code from parent dashboard
Shomer.AI needs Accessibility access to read text from messaging apps. Tap the button below, find \"Shomer.AI Monitoring Service\" in the list, and enable it.
Allow notifications so Shomer.AI can show the monitoring indicator and alert the parent device.
To monitor continuously, Shomer.AI must not be stopped by the battery optimizer. Tap below and select \"Don\'t optimize\" for Shomer.AI.
